title: Aero-Salvage · Endfield Puzzle Helper
heading: Aero-Salvage Solver
intro: Upload a clear screenshot showing the entire board and all balloon stock on the right, then recognize and solve in one click. You can also enter the puzzle code to reuse a validated puzzle from the catalog.

mode.screenshotNote: Recognize and solve from a screenshot of the complete board and stock
mode.codeNote: Reuse a validated puzzle by entering its screenshot code

capabilityMissing: The service has not declared balloon support. Submission is unavailable.

recognize.heading: Get an answer from your image
recognize.description: The previewed image is uploaded only when you click. Missing stock values are filled in only when the target total lift uniquely determines the missing lift or count; the inference is shown below. Otherwise, use a clearer, complete screenshot.

catalog.title: Puzzle catalog:
catalog.unavailable: Unavailable; using only the recognized screenshot puzzle

choice.title: Choose a puzzle:
choice.disputed: Code {{code}} has several different recorded puzzles. All have been kept; check them and choose the one to use.
choice.single: The screenshot puzzle did not pass catalog validation. Code {{code}} has one reliable catalog puzzle you can use.

result.unsatisfiableTitle: No solution for the puzzle recognized from this image.
result.unsatisfiableBody: Try a clear screenshot with the whole board and all balloon stock. This conclusion is shown only after exhaustive search.
result.timeoutBody: Solvability is still unknown. Please retry later.
result.noSolution: The service did not return a complete answer.
result.found: Placement found. Each number on the board is the lift of the balloon in that cell.
result.rule: Rule {{version}}: weighted lift is balanced along both axes.

failure.busy: The service is busy. Retry later.
failure.invalidRequest: Image rejected. Try a clear, complete screenshot.
failure.expired: Task expired or service restarted. Recognize again.
failure.request: Request did not complete. Retry later.
failure.noBoard: Could not locate the complete board. Use a clear screenshot showing the entire board and all balloon stock on the right.
failure.invalidImage: The image is unreadable, unsupported or too large. Try another clear, complete screenshot.
failure.timeout: Image recognition timed out. Try another clear, complete screenshot.
failure.generic: Image recognition failed. Retry later or use another clear, complete screenshot.
failure.solveResultUnknown: The service returned an unrecognized solution. Please retry later.
failure.recognitionResultMissing: The service did not return a valid recognition result. Please retry.
failure.solveUnavailable: Recognition is complete, but solving is currently unavailable. Please retry later.
failure.taskFailed: The task failed. Please retry later.
failure.cancelled: Recognition and solving cancelled. A running server task may take a moment to end.

query.heading: Load a puzzle by code
query.description: Enter a code from a previously recognized complete screenshot to solve its validated catalog puzzle without uploading again. If records differ, all candidates are listed for you to choose.
query.label: Puzzle code
query.help: Use WL-A followed by four digits. Letter case and spaces are normalized automatically.
query.emptyCode: Enter a puzzle code, for example WL-A1001.
query.autoSolve: The catalog has a single candidate, submitted for solving automatically (record status: {{status}}).
query.multiple: Different puzzles are recorded under this code. Check the stock and target total lift before choosing a candidate.
query.solveUnavailable: Solving is currently unavailable. Please retry later.
query.errorInvalidCode: Invalid code. Use WL-A followed by four digits, for example WL-A1001.
query.errorNotFound: No complete puzzle is recorded for this code. Recognize a complete screenshot first to add it to the catalog.
query.errorCatalogUnavailable: The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Retry later or use a screenshot.
query.errorFailed: Lookup did not complete. Please retry later.

examples.scopeIntro: Include 1: the complete board and target total lift, and 2: all stock. 3: the puzzle code is optional and enables catalog records and reuse after recognition.
examples.scopeAlt: Screenshot example highlighting the complete board, target total lift, all stock and optional puzzle code
examples.scopeCaptionBoard: 1 Required: complete board + target total lift (example 0/11)
examples.scopeCaptionInventory: 2 Required: level, lift and count for all stock
examples.codeIntro: The code is on the left, outside the board: WL-A followed by four digits (example WL-A1001). Code lookup needs only this text; no image upload.
examples.codeAlt: Code location example marking WL-A and four digits to the left of the board
examples.codeCaption: Code location only: WL-A + four digits (example WL-A1001)
